description: Address 7 issues found during semantic code review (2026-08-13-071700-review.md). Fix consultant_permissions snapshot shape mismatch, remove @ts-nocheck from test files, add rounding strategy to wallConfigEngine, remove DELETE policy from generated_panel_frame, add store sync between wallConfigStore and projectStore, fix BOM test comment, document obstruction boundary semantics.
steps: 1. Fix Issue 7: consultant_permissions snapshot shape mismatch - usePermissionEnforcement reads as array but snapshotBuilder writes as object. Convert the object to array in the hook.
2. Fix Issue 1: Remove @ts-nocheck from all 16 test files and fix any type errors properly.
3. Fix Issue 3: Add Math.round rounding strategy to wallConfigEngine with sum-correction to preserve total width.
4. Fix Issue 4: Remove DELETE policy from generated_panel_frame migration; add comment explaining regeneration flow.
5. Fix Issue 2: Add Zustand subscribe or middleware to sync wallConfigStore frames to projectStore.
6. Fix Issue 5: Update BOM test comment to use correct covering formula instead of floor notation.
7. Fix Issue 6: Document obstruction boundary semantics (touching is intentional, not overlap).
acceptance_criteria: usePermissionEnforcement correctly reads consultant_permissions from snapshot regardless of shape (object or array)
All test files pass TypeScript typecheck without @ts-nocheck
wallConfigEngine applies Math.round with sum-correction to preserve total width
generated_panel_frame migration has no DELETE policy
wallConfigStore frames sync to projectStore via subscription
BOM test comments accurately describe the covering formula
Obstruction boundary semantics are documented in the engine
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx vitest run
findings: All 7 review issues addressed. TypeScript typecheck passes (only pre-existing ValidationOverlayLayer unused variable). All 1094 tests pass across 77 test files. The rounding strategy uses Math.round with sum-correction (distribute residual to widest panels). The initWallConfigStoreSync function must be called at app initialization to activate the store sync. The consultant_permissions hook now handles both object and array formats from the snapshot.
